description: Merkle fixtures shared by programs/vicinity-rewards/src/merkle.rs and sdk/merkle.mjs. Both must reproduce every root, every proof and every leaf hash exactly.

encoding.amount: u64 as a decimal string (may exceed 2^53)
encoding.proofs: map from leaf index (string) to the list of sibling hashes (hex), leaf level first

rules.leaf: sha256(0x00 || index as u32 little endian || claimant 32 bytes || amount as u64 little endian)
rules.node: sha256(0x01 || min(left, right) || max(left, right))  (byte-wise comparison, so proofs carry no direction bits)
rules.odd_node: when a level has an odd number of nodes, the last node is promoted unchanged to the next level
rules.single_leaf: a tree with one leaf has root == leaf and an empty proof
